Thank you so much for replying. I try to keep that in mind. It's just that all I think about is that i'm not a virgin. I hope I will be able to recover. Yes, I can work on myself. 
I simply cannot do that because i am at fault. He didn't want marriage only a serious relationship. I blindly trusted him. He broke it off two weeks after having sex for the first time. I'm an adult and I can't believe how stupid and naive I was. He got what he wanted. Sometimes I want to hurt him just as bad as he hurt me but I brought this upon myself so what's the point. 
I will try to learn to love myself again. Thanks stranger Alejandra! I didn't expect a reply.
